tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search BostonVacay's curated directory of Boston, Massachusetts businesses (hotels, restaurants, attractions, bars and shops). Read-only. Filters: keyword, category, area/neighborhood, price tier, amenities (e.g. pool, spa, pet_friendly, rooftop, family_friendly), tag, and distance from a lat/lng or

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Read-only. List the BostonVacay directory's top-level categories with listing counts.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Read-only. Values usable in search_listings: areas/neighborhoods, price tiers, amenities and tags, each with listing counts, plus notes on how each is derived.

tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Read-only. Live search of bookable tours and activities in Boston, Massachusetts from Viator's partner API. Returns title, live starting ('from') price and currency, rating, review count, duration, free-cancellation flag, image and a booking_url. Optional start_date/end_date return only products Via

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search BostonVacay business listings by keyword and/or category. Returns sanitized public listings (name, description, address, phone, hours, photos, booking links). Only quality listings are returned: publicly active, with a real name and a real description (50+ chars)." → after: "Search BostonVacay's curated directory of Boston, Massachusetts businesses (hotels, restaurants, attractions, bars and shops). Read-only. Filters: keyword, category, area/neighborhood, price tier, amenities (e.g. pool, spa, pet_friendly, rooftop, family_friendly), tag, and distance from a lat/lng or"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
